# Vasubandhu and the industries that were always telling its story

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Vasubandhu** works now.

The stories of Vasubandhu place abhidharma, yogacara at the center of a living mythological world.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Vasubandhu
- **Pantheon:** Buddhist
- **Domain of influence:** Abhidharma, Yogacara
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Health & Wellbeing
- **Strongest seat:** Faith & Spiritual Organizations
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 515 of 546

## The Myth at Work

**Origins.** Vasubandhu appears in buddhist tradition as abhidharma, yogacara.  The name's meaning, "The celebrated Buddhist scholar — author of the Abhidharmakośa, co-founder of the Yogācāra school", shapes the narratives told about this figure. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**Worship and Memory.** Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Vasubandhu in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Primary seat: Vasubandhu embodies abhidharma, yogacara — the core of faith.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Mental Health & Emotional Wellness

*Therapy, emotional wellbeing, and mindfulness. (Sector: Health & Wellbeing)*

*Resonant seat: Vasubandhu shares symbolic territory with mental health.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Vasubandhu performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Philosophy, Ethics & Standards

*Philosophy, ethics boards, and standards bodies. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Resonant seat: Vasubandhu shares symbolic territory with philosophy ethics.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Yoga, Meditation & Holistic Wellness

*Yoga, meditation, and mind-body practice. (Sector: Health & Wellbeing)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Resonant seat: Vasubandhu shares symbolic territory with wellness mind.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

## The Long Employment

Vasubandhu remains a touchstone for understanding buddhist religion, art, and identity. The age changed. The work did not.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

Skeptical? Good — the system is built for you. Every seat in this file carries its why-line and its weight, the full derivation is public at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/), and the challenge process is part of the design. Falsifiable is not a posture here; it is the mechanism.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in faith & spiritual organizations, mental health & emotional wellness, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/vasubandhu/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
